_note: Post-event photos and videos. The usual route is the schedule sheet: paste a Drive folder link in the event row's Gallery column (shared: anyone with the link) and the hourly sync fills this file. 'parent' is an optional Drive folder holding one sub-folder per event, named like the event. Filled by tools/sync-event-media.py (hourly); the site reads it for 'What has already happened'. Leave 'parent' empty until the team's folder exists.
